import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival Rate by Sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
survival_by_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 2. Survival Rate by Class
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
survival_by_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean()
survival_by_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#AA96DA'])
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax2.set_xlabel('Class')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
df['age'].dropna().hist(ax=ax3, bins=10, color='#A8E6CF', edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 4. Survival Count
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
ax4.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Died', 'Survived'], autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Overall Survival Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Fare Distribution by Class
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
for cls in df['class'].unique():
    class_data = df[df['class'] == cls]['fare']
    ax5.hist(class_data, alpha=0.6, label=cls, bins=5)
ax5.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Fare')
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax5.legend()

# 6. Survival by Embarkation Town
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
survival_by_town = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean()
survival_by_town.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=['#FFD93D', '#6BCB77', '#4D96FF'])
ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax6.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town')
ax6.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Age vs Fare Scatter
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
colors = df['survived'].map({0: '#FF6B6B', 1: '#4ECDC4'})
ax7.scatter(df['age'], df['fare'], c=colors, alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax7.set_title('Age vs Fare (colored by survival)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Age')
ax7.set_ylabel('Fare')

# 8. Family Size (SibSp + Parch)
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch']
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
family_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax8, color='#C4B5FD')
ax8.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax8.set_xlabel('Family Size (SibSp + Parch)')
ax8.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 9. Survival Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='survived', index='sex', columns='class', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='RdYlGn', ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'label': 'Survival Rate'})
ax9.set_title('Survival Rate: Sex vs Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Class')
ax9.set_ylabel('Sex')

plt.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
